about: .LACAIXA is a generic top-level domain (gTLD) delegated in the DNS root zone. The registry operator responsible for .LACAIXA is listed by IANA as Fundación Bancaria Caixa d'Estalvis i Pensions de Barcelona, "la Caixa". Anyone can typically register a .LACAIXA name through an accredited registrar, subject to the registry’s registration policy and ICANN consensus policies.
